content:
OWNER SIGN-IN IS NOT VERIFIED UNTIL MY DEVICE PASSES.

Do not provide another PASS report.

Reproduce the exact failure on my device.

Collect and return:

1. Exact timestamp of the failed login.
2. API request and response (status code only; redact secrets).
3. Backend logs for that request.
4. Auth logs showing why the login succeeded or failed.
5. JWT/session creation result.
6. Whether the app is connected to production or another environment.
7. If the problem cannot be reproduced, explain exactly why my device behaves differently.

Do not mark this VERIFIED until I can log in successfully on my phone using the production app.
